website.note: Company is consumer-health/dietary-supplement focused; no clinical drug pipeline page

ctgov.note: Searched ChromaDex (former corporate name); trials are investigator-initiated nutritional studies of nicotinamide riboside (Niagen), not company-sponsored drug development; not company-owned investigational new drugs

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Niagen Bioscience (formerly ChromaDex) is a commercial-stage consumer health and bioscience company selling nicotinamide riboside (NR) products under the Niagen and Tru Niagen brands as dietary supplements and pharmaceutical-grade compounded preparations. The company does not develop investigational new drug candidates; ClinicalTrials.gov shows only investigator-initiated nutritional studies. No active P1/P2/P3 IND-stage drug programs.

products: Niagen Plus (pharmaceutical-grade NR for 503B outsourcing facilities; compounded Niagen IV / injectable formulations)
commercial_product.regulatory_status: GRAS (food-grade); FDA-permitted for compounding by 503B outsourcing facilities (pharmaceutical-grade)

excluded_partner_owned: Investigator-initiated NR studies sponsored by KGK Science, Oslo University Hospital, University of California Davis, University of Colorado Boulder, etc.
